## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#| echo: false
# start out with a number to test
x <- 643
# you'll want your function to return this number
x^2
square <- function(x) {
	product_val <- x * x
	return(product_val)
} 


```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# start out with a number to test

x^2

	return(product_val)

```

```{r}
#| echo: false

raise <- function(x, power)
	{ raise_product  <-  x^power 
return(raise_product)
}


raise(x = 2, power = 4)





```

```{r}
#| echo: false
sd_function <- function(x) {
	if (length (x) <= 1) {
		return(NA)
	}
	n <- length(x)
	mean_val <- sum(x) / n
	variance<- (x - mean_val)^2
	sd_product  <- sum(variance) / (n - 1)
	standard <- (sqrt(sd_product))
 return(standard)
} 
sd_function(c(167, 200, 5, 67, 3508, 4))

sd_function(c(400, 5768, 2, 33, 3,00,987, 45,000))

sd_function(c(2, 4, 2, 4, 2, 4, 2, 4, 2, 4, 2, 4, 2))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
sd_function <- function(x) {
	if (length (x) <= 1) {
		return(NA)
	}
	n <- length(x)
	mean_val <- sum(x) / n
	variance<- (x - mean_val)^2
	sd_product  <- sum(variance) / (n - 1)
	standard <- (sqrt(sd_product))
	return(standard)
} 
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

raise <- function(x, power=1)
{ raise_product  <-  x^power 
return(raise_product)
}


raise(x = 2, power = 4)

for (i in 1:100) {
	print(raise(x = i, power = 2))
}


```
